captions.text: Hey Prosperity Roofing team,
I know in roofing,
the first company to answer usually gets
the job, and missed calls can mean
a voicemail, a slow follow-up,
and a competitor booking it before you
even see the lead.
I built something that fixes that.
When you can't get to the phone,
our AI calls the lead back within
30 seconds, qualifies what they need,
books the job straight to your calendar,
and texts your team the details.
You keep your current number,
your website and Google setup stay the
same, and we build and train it
on Prosperity Roofing in 48 hours.
In week one, we can even reactivate
your old missed-call list to start turning
lost leads into booked work.
It's $197 a month locked for life,
no setup fee for founding operators,
month-to-month, and you do not pay until
it books your first job.
If it makes sense,
I would be happy to show you
how it would work for your team.
